description: The bar chart illustrates benchmark scores for three Korean language models across multiple evaluation datasets, showing side-by-side comparisons within each dataset category. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks labeled (left to right) PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, with no additional grouping beyond these categories. The vertical axis is a numeric score scale (linear) with values shown directly as data labels above bars; the plotted values range from about 0.42 up to 1.00, and the axis itself has no visible tick labels or unit annotation beyond the numeric labels on bars. Each category contains three adjacent bars: a dark purple bar labeled “RedWhale (our),” a blue-gray bar labeled “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0,” and a light gray bar labeled “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base).” For PT-EVAL, the bars are approximately 0.42 (RedWhale), 0.46 (EEVE), and 1.00 (SOLAR). For KoBEST-BQ, they are about 0.52, 0.56, and 1.00; for KoBEST-CP, about 0.71, 0.74, and 1.00; for KoBEST-HS, about 0.50, 0.54, and 1.00; for KoBEST-SN, about 0.69, 0.73, and 1.00; and for AVG, about 0.57, 0.61, and 1.00. The bars are not sorted by height; they follow the benchmark order shown on the x-axis, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond consistent color-coding and the numeric value annotations above each bar.
